title: Kicked Peppery Ethiopian Corned Beef Kitfo
description: A peppery and tender Ethiopian dish featuring corned beef, made quick and easy with a pressure cooker, and Whole30-friendly, served in a traditional kitfo form.
instructions: Press the saute button on the pressure cooker and heat the niter kibbeh until melted.
Add the sliced corned beef to the pressure cooker and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the mitmita, garlic, ginger, berbere spice, salt, and black pepper to the pressure cooker and stir to combine.
Close the lid of the pressure cooker and set the valve to sealing, then set the cooking time to 10 minutes at high pressure.
When the cooking time is up, allow the pressure to release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Stir in the lemon juice and chopped scallions.
Serve the corned beef mixture on a plate or injera bread, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
Traditionally, kitfo is served raw, but in this recipe, we use the pressure cooker to cook the corned beef to a safe internal temperature.
